reel_hook: Every US flight stopped. Here's why.

slides.title: US flights grounded for hours
slides.image_prompt: Rows of parked passenger jets on a dark airport tarmac at night, a tangle of glowing overheated network cables and routers in the foreground
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The FAA halted all US departures for over four hours Friday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Overloaded, old network gear knocked out radar and communications.
FOR YOU
Flying this weekend? Check your flight status; delays continued Saturday morning.
slides.body: The FAA halted all US departures for over four hours Friday. Overloaded, old network gear knocked out radar and communications. Flying this weekend? Check your flight status; delays continued Saturday morning.

slides.title: Outlook down for two workdays
slides.image_prompt: An empty office desk with a closed laptop, a paper envelope caught in a tangle of unplugged cables, cold blue light
slides.label: TECHNOLOGY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down worldwide from Thursday.
WHY IT MATTERS
Businesses and governments around the world lost access to email.
FOR YOU
Missing emails from Thursday or Friday? Microsoft says queues are nearly back to normal.
slides.body: Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down worldwide from Thursday. Businesses and governments around the world lost access to email. Missing emails from Thursday or Friday? Microsoft says queues are nearly back to normal.

slides.title: Supreme Court takes asylum case
slides.image_prompt: Marble courthouse columns at dawn with a wooden gavel resting on a stone step, a desert border fence faint in the background
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The Supreme Court will hear Trump's border asylum restrictions case.
WHY IT MATTERS
Lower courts ruled it unlawful, yet it stays enforced.
FOR YOU
Nothing changes yet: the policy stays until a ruling, expected by summer 2027.
slides.body: The Supreme Court will hear Trump's border asylum restrictions case. Lower courts ruled it unlawful, yet it stays enforced. Nothing changes yet: the policy stays until a ruling, expected by summer 2027.

slides.title: Floods hit Gaza's tent camps
slides.image_prompt: Rows of white tents standing in muddy floodwater under heavy grey rain clouds, puddles reflecting the sky
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Heavy rain has flooded Gaza tents since 6 November.
WHY IT MATTERS
WHO says respiratory infections are rising among the displaced.
FOR YOU
Not directly. The UN expects more waterborne disease and hypothermia this winter.
slides.body: Heavy rain has flooded Gaza tents since 6 November. WHO says respiratory infections are rising among the displaced. Not directly. The UN expects more waterborne disease and hypothermia this winter.

slides.title: Pope Leo returns to Peru
slides.image_prompt: A white papal skullcap resting on an open-air altar under a bright Peruvian sky, flower petals scattered across the ground
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Pope Leo XIV celebrated Mass in Pimentel, near Chiclayo, Peru.
WHY IT MATTERS
He once served as bishop there; crowds cheered his return.
FOR YOU
Nothing practical, just a warm moment: a pope cheered back in his old diocese.
slides.body: Pope Leo XIV celebrated Mass in Pimentel, near Chiclayo, Peru. He once served as bishop there; crowds cheered his return. Nothing practical, just a warm moment: a pope cheered back in his old diocese.

caption:
✈️ The FAA stopped all US departures for over four hours. Flying this weekend? Check your flight, delays continued Saturday.
📧 Outlook, Teams and Copilot went down worldwide for two workdays. Missing emails should be arriving now.
⚖️ The Supreme Court will rule on Trump's asylum restrictions, decision expected by summer 2027.
🌧️ Floods in Gaza's tent camps: WHO reports rising respiratory infections.
🇵🇪 Pope Leo XIV made an emotional return to Peru.
